remarks: Welcome to this stately, sun-filled brick townhome, built by renowned builder the late Archie Stewart, celebrated for quality construction, generous room sizes, and exceptional storage. Tucked within a quiet, private enclave, this residence offers an ideal blend of classic charm and everyday convenience. The spacious living room, centered around a fireplace, opens directly to a private patio, perfect for outdoor dining, relaxing, or entertaining. Upstairs, you'll find two large ensuite bedrooms, including a gracious primary suite, both featuring abundant closet space, plus the ease of second-floor laundry. Additional highlights include a full walk-up attic, full basement, central air conditioning, central vacuum, and a security system. Extra parking is available in the St. A's parking lot. Best of all, you're just a stone's throw from New Canaan's unique shops, award-winning restaurants, and the Metro-North train. A rare opportunity for comfortable, low-maintenance living with space, light, and storage to spare, right near the village of New Canaan. St. Aloysius' priests live in the adjacent unit. Small dog ok.
